component.button.danger.background.description: Destructive command background in light mode.

component.button.danger.backgroundHover.description: Destructive command hover background in light mode. Step-10 hover companion to the red solid fill.

component.button.danger.backgroundHoverD.description: Destructive command hover background in dark mode. Step-10 hover companion to the red solid fill.

component.button.danger.foreground.description: Text or icon color on destructive command backgrounds.

component.button.info.background.description: Neutral solid command background in light mode.

component.button.info.backgroundDark.description: Neutral solid command background in dark mode.

component.button.info.backgroundHover.description: Neutral solid command hover background in light mode.

component.button.info.backgroundHoverDar.description: Neutral solid command hover background in dark mode.

component.button.info.foreground.description: Label on the neutral solid — mode-aware for AA contrast on the gray fill.

component.button.info.foregroundDark.description: Label on the neutral solid in dark mode.

component.button.default.background.description: Quiet default button fill in light mode.

component.button.default.backgroundDark.description: Quiet default button fill in dark mode.

component.button.default.backgroundHover.description: Default button hover fill in light mode.
Default button hover fill in dark mode.

component.button.default.foreground.description: Default button label in light mode.

component.button.default.foregroundDark.description: Default button label in dark mode.

component.button.ghost.background.description: Ghost tier rests with no fill and no border.

component.button.ghost.foreground.description: Ghost label at rest in light mode.

component.button.ghost.foregroundDark.description: Ghost label at rest in dark mode.

component.button.ghost.foregroundHover.description: Ghost label on hover in light mode. The lift is mandatory.

component.button.ghost.foregroundHoverDa.description: Ghost label on hover in dark mode. The lift is mandatory.

component.button.ghost.backgroundHover.description: Shared quiet-fill hover step in light mode.

component.button.ghost.backgroundHoverDa.description: Shared quiet-fill hover step in dark mode.

component.button.heightMd.description: Medium button box. The site top-bar CTA size.

component.button.paddingX.description: Horizontal padding for lg, md and sm.

component.nav.heightCompact.description: Sticky top bar height on narrow viewports.

component.nav.ctaHeight.description: The top-bar CTA box. Always the md button.

component.input.borderHover.description: shadcn-friendly alias of --field-border-hover. Always aliases the field token so the two name systems cannot drift.

component.field.background.description: Form-control fill. Fields stay on the app background surface, even inside a raised panel.

component.field.borderFocus.description: Focused form-control border. Focus matches hover and does not use the yellow focus shadow.

component.field.borderFocusDark.description: Dark-mode focused form-control border. Focus matches hover and does not use the yellow focus shadow.

component.field.ring.description: Quiet field focus ring. Brand-yellow shadow focus is reserved for buttons, links, nav, and TV focus.

component.field.ringDark.description: Dark-mode quiet field focus ring. Brand-yellow shadow focus is reserved for buttons, links, nav, and TV focus.

component.panel.background.description: Raised panel background on the app background surface.

component.panel.backgroundDark.description: Dark-mode raised panel background on the app background surface.

component.alias.invertForeground.description: Text or icon color on invert command backgrounds in light mode.

component.alias.invertForegroundDark.description: Text or icon color on invert command backgrounds in dark mode.

component.fileRow.border.description: Row divider. File lists divide with a hairline, never zebra stripes or per-row cards.

component.fileRow.icon.description: Every file kind takes this, not just the folder — folder, video, audio, image, archive, generic file alike. Utility and chrome icons stay neutral.

component.sheet.width.description: Fixed on web. Touch surfaces use a bottom sheet instead.

context.tv.text.primary.description: Row titles, modal option labels, and button labels.

context.tv.text.secondary.description: Row sublines, modal titles, section headers, and accessories.

tv.text.label.description: text.label · GTAmerica-Md. Screen titles, and the file-row icon size.

tv.text.caption.description: text.caption · GTAmerica-Rg. Row subline and button icons. TV has no mono face — the size subline renders in GT America with tabular figures, so the Berkeley Mono numeric rule is web and mobile only.

tv.text.smol.description: text.smol · GTAmerica-Rg. Button labels, rendered uppercase.

tv.space.md.description: The workhorse step: uniform list-row padding, row gap, and header padding-bottom.

tv.overscan.x.description: Horizontal safe-area ratio. Platform adapters multiply this value by viewport width.

tv.overscan.y.description: Vertical safe-area ratio. Platform adapters multiply this value by viewport height.

tv.radius.description: radii.default — one radius for every 10-foot surface.

tv.z.overlay.description: Above toast — the opposite of the web scale, where --z-notification (1400) sits above --z-modal (1300).

color.brand.yellow.description: put.io brand yellow (canonical hex #FDCE45). The resting brand fill is the same in light and dark modes.

color.yellow.light.solidHover.description: Primary-button hover yellow for light mode.

color.yellow.dark.solidHover.description: Primary-button hover yellow for dark mode.

elevation.color.description: Compat name kept for existing web consumers — alias of elevation.shadowColor so the two can never drift.

typography.fontFamily.mono.description: The single mono face: numerics, timestamps, file sizes, ETAs, counts, code, logs, magnet URIs, identifiers, and filenames. Web and mobile only — TV has no mono face.

typography.fontSize.sm.description: Caption and button labels — production fontSize 0.

typography.fontSize.base.description: Body, labels, inputs — production fontSize 1; equals the responsive root (14px, 15px at >= breakpoint.lg).

typography.fontSize.2xl.description: Fixed display tier — does not scale with the responsive root.

typography.fontSize.3xl.description: Fixed display tier — does not scale with the responsive root.

typography.fontSize.4xl.description: Compatibility alias for the former 4xl tier; new surfaces should use fontSize.3xl or fontSize.display.

typography.fontSize.display.description: Fixed display tier for brand display moments.

radius.tv.description: The corner radius for every 10-foot surface — list rows, buttons, sheets, cards, code tiles, and keys. TV uses one radius, not a scale; the only other radii on TV are intentional pills and circles.

breakpoint.lg.description: The root font-size steps from 14px to 15px at this width.

surface.dark.shadow.description: Compat name kept for existing web consumers — alias of surface.dark.shadowColor so the two can never drift.
